scientific_integrity: New claims are the Shrikhande minimum-code classification, exact counts and both optimum exchange-graph structures; the pre-existing rook minimum is explicitly credited. Mathematical verification rests on explicit combinatorial arguments and two executable finite exhaustive checks. No fabricated publication priority or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite theorem for the Shrikhande and four-by-four rook graphs; no assertion for other graphs, larger Doob products, or other exchange models. The rook minimum-size equality is prior art. Exhaustive implementations do not constitute external independent review.
title: Optimal identifying-code exchange geometry of the Shrikhande and \(4\times4\) rook graphs
